Powinieneś w tym momencie mieć ok. 20x@unit_delhi/scholar.webp@.

description:
Aggressive build order to slow down the opponent and distract them while you capture sacred sites and prepare for a fast age-up.
Start by making ghazi to raid with and follow up with archers or spears to counter enemy army.

Check my other delhi guides:
- Feudal tempo (ToV): https://aoe4guides.com/builds/PfkaGj9MlMiRmBPefOSx
name: Delhi | Ghazi aggression / Fast Castle
author: Jockxtar

notes: Make @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ at @landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@ as soon as you get the @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (7 is a good amount to start saving up for @age/age_3.webp@).

Move @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ from inside @building_military/stable.webp@ to @building_military/barracks.webp@/@building_military/archery-range.webp@; or to @building_religious/mosque.webp@ to accelerate research speed.
If you build @building_military/archery-range.webp@, you will need at least 12 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Use @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@ to raid while you get a decent group of @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@/@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ in your base.

Use @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@/@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ to build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ around your base and to escort @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ while they capture @resource/sacred_sites.webp@
Move @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ to capture @resource/sacred_sites.webp@ a few seconds before @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@ finishes.

Don't fight too hard for @resource/sacred_sites.webp@. Use them as a distraction, forcing the enemies to move out of their base and creating more opportunitites to raid. Obviously the extra @resource/resource_gold.webp@ is nice, but don't take bad fights to defend them.

If you are forced to stay in @age/age_2.webp@ for longer and make units, train additional @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ so you don't float over 600 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, or trade it for @resource/resource_food.webp@ at a @building_economy/market.webp@ for a faster @age/age_3.webp@
Train additional @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ (but never going below 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, you will need it for units)
A few seconds before @age/age_3.webp@ move @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ near @resource/relics.webp@ to grab them as soon as you age up.
If you are scared of @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ diving your base, make 1 @unit_delhi/war-elephant.webp@ first to defend alongside @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@

Make 4 @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to steal @resource/deer.webp@ from the opponent's side of the map once @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ finishes, securing @resource/resource_food.webp@ and delaying the farm transition.
<- Ideal economy should look like this
After technologies are done, garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside military buildings or move them out to heal units after fights.
Delay @building_economy/farm.webp@ transition as much as possible, gather from @resource/berrybush.webp@ and @resource/deer.webp@ instead.

@landmark_delhi/palace-of-the-sultan.webp@: good long-term value. @unit_delhi/sultans-elite-tower-elephant-4.webp@ are the strongest unit in the game and a push with 5 or more of them with a full army can be devastating.

@landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@: for faster tempo (faster late game upgrades) and better food economy. Allows you to liberate population space for a bigger army while keeping high production of @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ and @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@
Make @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ up to 20, but don't build more than 3 @building_religious/mosque.webp@.
After upgrades are completed move @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ with the army to heal during fights.
<- Ideal economy should look like this

description:
Defensive build order with early spears to counter early raids and block pro scouts and relics.

Good to secure sacred sites early against cavalry civs and in team games to protect your allies building walls around the bases.

Check my other delhi guides:
- Ghazi aggression / Fast Castle: https://aoe4guides.com/builds/lqCTiEwm9Awa7szrZFig
name: Delhi | Feudal tempo (ToV)
author: Jockxtar

notes: Put 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside @building_military/archery-range.webp@ once you start floating @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and mass a big ball of @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@. Make enough @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to defend the @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ and spend the rest of the @resource/resource_food.webp@ on @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@

If you want to all-in, change @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@ upgrade order to: @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ -> @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ -> @technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@ -> @technology_military/bloomery.webp@ -> @technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.webp@
So you can start making @unit_siege/battering-ram.webp@ early.
Make only units if necessary to defend.
Build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ with @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ while @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@ raid enemy economy.
Move 3 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if you are not making @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@

Move @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ to @resource/sacred_sites.webp@ a few seconds before @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@ finishes. If a @resource/sacred_sites.webp@ is not safe, scort the @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ with your army.
Never risk loosing @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@, they are very expensive without @landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.webp@
After @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@ is researched, spend @resource/resource_gold.webp@ on @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ (at least 5 before @age/age_3.webp@)

If you are forced to stay in @age/age_2.webp@ for too long, train additional @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ so you don't float over 600 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, or trade it for @resource/resource_food.webp@ at a @building_economy/market.webp@ for a faster @age/age_3.webp@.
Build small @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ around @resource/relics.webp@ to deny them from opponents playing for Fast Castle.
@landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.webp@: Better in most situations. Good for scaling both the army and the economy.

@landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@: Good in match-ups where you want to play defensive and boom your economy as soon as possible, extending @age/age_3.webp@ until you can safely go to @age/age_4.webp@
Train additional @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@. At least 5 before @age/age_3.webp@, but never going below 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@, you will need it for units.
Put 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside @building_military/stable.webp@ right before landmark is completed
If you have enough economy, make @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@ and @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ depending on the enemy army.

Research @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ and @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@ @age/age_3.webp@ upgrade with the second @building_military/barracks.webp@/@building_military/archery-range.webp@/@building_military/stable.webp@
Depending on how defensive the enemies are playing:
@abilities/repair.webp@@building_defensive/keep.webp@ in your base to defend against raids.
@abilities/repair.webp@@building_defensive/keep.webp@ to protect key resources in the middle of the map.
*@landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@: Build @building_defensive/stone-wall.webp@ with infantry to protect your base.
3 @building_defensive/keep.webp@ is a good amount to stop gathering @resource/resource_stone.webp@.
<- Ideal economy should look like this
After technologies are done, garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside military buildings or move them out to heal units after fights.
Delay @building_economy/farm.webp@ transition as much as possible, gather from @resource/berrybush.webp@ and @resource/deer.webp@ instead.

@landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@: for faster tempo (faster late game upgrades) and better food economy. Allows you to liberate population space for a bigger army while keeping high production of @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ and @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@

@landmark_delhi/palace-of-the-sultan.webp@: produces @unit_delhi/sultans-elite-tower-elephant-4.webp@, which are very strong, but not quite as strong as @unit_infantry/handcannoneer-4.webp@ with @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@
Make @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ up to 20, but don't build more than 3 @building_religious/mosque.webp@, the other will garrison on @landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@.
Research all upgrades, both economic and military, even the ones from @building_military/dock.webp@ if the map has water.

After unit upgrades, economic technologies, @technology_military/elite-army-tactics.webp@ and @technology_military/biology.webp@ are completed: Garrison a few @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside military buildings.
With this army composition, @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ healing is not as important as if we were playing with elephants.
Build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@/@building_defensive/stone-wall.webp@ with your units as you push into the opponent's side of the map to protect reinforcements and control resources.
<- Ideal economy should look like this
